RESULT — Each additional ongoing medical condition is associated with an approximately 39% increase in the odds of higher COVID-19/infection severity (proportional-odds ordinal logistic model), controlling for BCG vaccination status and patient interaction variables.

HEADLINE (primary model): **≈39% (38.7%) increase in odds per additional ongoing condition**; OR = 1.39 (95% CI 1.24–1.55, i.e., +24.3% to +54.8%), β = 0.327, p ≈ 5×10⁻⁹, n = 954 of 1,000 subjects (46 subjects with RTI AEs but unknown AESEV excluded).

Model specification: OrderedModel (logit link), outcome = subject-level max AESEV among RTI-category AEs, 0 = no RTI/COVID-19 AE (5 ordered levels 0–4: 0:425, 1:253, 2:253, 3:16, 4:7); covariates: n_ongoing (count of MHONGO=='Yes' MEDICAL HISTORY conditions per subject, zero-filled, deduped by normalized term — dedupe affected 0 subjects, 910 Yes-rows unchanged), TRTGRP (BCG=1 vs Placebo; β=0.22, p=0.07), patients_seen (ordinal 0/1/2; β=0.04, p=0.73), expect_interact (Yes=1; β=0.16, p=0.21). Thresholds estimated at all 4 cuts.

Sensitivities (n_ongoing odds increase, all in the same direction):
- Primary collapsed (0,1,2,severe=3): 38.6% (24.2–54.7%), n=954
- Unknown AESEV imputed (AESER='Yes'→3, else 1), n=1000: 38.0% (24.0–53.6%)
- COVID-19-AE-only outcome (COVID/SARS-CoV-2 AEPTs), n=956: 32.3% (14.5–52.7%)
- COVID-only collapsed: 32.1% (14.4–52.5%)
- + age (band midpoint) and sex: 35.0% (20.4–51.4%)

Proportional-odds diagnostic (cut-specific binary logits on primary sample): β_n_ongoing = +0.28 (>0), +0.33 (>1), +0.63 (>2), +0.70 (>3). PO is well supported at the none/mild/moderate cuts (matches the pooled 0.327) but the effect is larger for transitions into severe levels; the pooled PO estimate is therefore conservative for the severe tail, and the single reported figure (~39%) is a reasonable average across cuts.

Limitations carried from the plan: AESEV labels (mild→fatal) assumed monotone (AESER cross-check confirms ordering); "COVID-19 severity" operationalized as RTI/COVID max severity since no subject-level severity variable exists; no data dictionary for RACE/education/SEX; sparse upper tail (AESEV 3–4).

Artifacts: executed script /workspace/analysis_bix29_q2.py; full output log /workspace/analysis_output.log.
